title: Cognitive Lens ("Hat") Card
description: One of the six cognitive lenses used across the Generate/Evaluate/Refine stages of the agent-loop architecture. A hat card can supply a generation persona, an evaluation rubric, a refinement/repair strategy, or any combination -- a hat is defined once and reused across whichever stages need it.

id.description: Unique short id, e.g. 'black', 'white'. Custom hats beyond the canonical six are allowed as long as `lens` names what cognitive dimension they cover.

lens.description: The cognitive dimension this hat evaluates or generates for -- facts (White), value (Yellow), risk (Black), feelings (Red), creativity (Green), process (Blue).

veto.description: If true, this hat's score falling below its pass_threshold is a hard, automatic fail (Escalate/Reject) regardless of every other hat's score or the aggregate weighted average. This must be enforced as a deterministic check in the orchestrator, never left to a prompt asking the Blue Hat to 'remember to veto' -- see agent-loop/README.md's Design Principles.

weight.description: Used ONLY to compute the aggregate score that the convergence/improvement-delta check (the Yellow Hat heuristic) tracks across iterations. Never used for pass/fail -- that is pass_threshold's and veto's job alone. Keeping these separate avoids the ambiguity of the original design, where weight and threshold could silently disagree about whether a hat's failure mattered.

pass_threshold.description: Score (1-10) this hat must meet or exceed during evaluation to count as passing.

generate_persona.description: Used when this hat is selected as the cognitive lens for the Generate stage.

output_schema.description: Free-text description of the expected output shape, e.g. 'a Risk Register with Severity and Likelihood columns'.

intensity_scale.description: Whether this persona supports an intensity 0-10 knob controlling how strongly the lens dominates the draft.

evaluate_rubric.description: Used when this hat participates in the Evaluate stage's ensemble.

scoring_anchors.description: Concrete anchors for at least the 1, 5, and 10 points on this hat's 1-10 scale.

refine_strategy.description: Used when this hat's axis is the one the Blue Hat diagnoses as failing, and this hat is deployed as the targeted repair.

preservation_lock.description: Whether this strategy's prompt must instruct the model to leave every already-passing axis untouched (see loop-config's preservation_locking).

source_skills.description: Forward-looking, currently unused: skill IDs from skills/*/skill.yaml (e.g. 'style-support.style-mechanics') that this hat's instructions will eventually derive from, once Foundations/Elements/Style-support content is merged into agent-loop. Empty until that merge happens -- do not populate speculatively.
